title: Tooling, CI and the run classes
focus: Which rules a deterministic check, a lint rule or a type would enforce better than an audit (criterion 3); CI and audit configuration whose cost buys no signal, or whose classification of a run is wrong (23); the same concern held by a CI job and a specification or a skill (21).

title: Tests citing the corpus
focus: Tests bound to the specifications that satisfy the wording while failing to protect the intent (5), that are low-value or artificial (4), or whose verification relies on comments or textual matching (17).

title: Comments and citations
focus: Citation machinery whose upkeep exceeds its value (24), citations standing in for evidence (17), comments restating a rule the specification owns (21).

title: Missing invariants
focus: High-value invariants the architecture clearly relies on that no requirement states (13), and implementation suggesting a specification is wrong or outdated (12).

title: Placement
focus: Rules that belong in AGENTS.md, a scoped rule, a skill, a command, the OPSX config or a README rather than the specification, and the reverse (2); the same concern held by two mechanisms (21); AGENTS.md hierarchy and scoped-rule scope. Judge by the placement guide, rules/agent.md.
